values: 2274 / Erdős Problem 711 — divergence of max_m f(n,m)-f(n,n), Erdős–Pomerance (1980) / Erdős (1992), p.36

Wouter van Doorn, On the Length of an Interval That Contains Distinct Multiples of the First n Positive Integers, Integers 26 (2026), A7, published 5 January 2026. Theorem 1 proves F(n)-f(n,n)>0.36 n log n/log log n for all sufficiently large n, resolving the original divergent-gap conjecture in EP711. The separate uniform exponent-one upper question remains unresolved by this paper. Existing journal publication; no new upload. Complete three-page aa7.pdf independently matched between Zenodo and publisher, checksum verified and DOI resolved. Prior theorem audited in PR1186: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1186 .
